synthesis.headline: Management is failing to deliver on growth promises amid dropping medium-term targets and compressed margins.

points.text: FY27 revenue growth is off-track at 7.6% across two quarters against a promised 30% target.
Management dropped multiple strategic targets, including FY27/mid-term EBITDA margins, solutions business transition timelines, carbon footprint goals, and 60% solutions revenue share.
Operating margins contracted significantly, dropping from 21.1% in Mar 2025 down to 15.8% in Sep 2026.
Despite margin pressures, annual revenue grew consistently from ₹2,036 crore in Mar 2021 to ₹6,455 crore in Mar 2026.

bull.text: Cash generation remains strong with CFO/PAT ratios above 1.65x over the last 3 years, reaching ₹1,195 crore in Mar 2026.
The balance sheet maintains a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.21 with ROCE at a healthy 26.0% as of Sep 2026.

bear.text: FY27 growth outlook is off-track at just 7.6% actual revenue growth reported so far against a 30% promise.
Annual PAT dropped from ₹840 crore in Mar 2025 to ₹637 crore in Mar 2026 as operating margins declined.

business.what: KPIT Technologies is a global technology company providing software solutions, services, and products to mobility and automotive ecosystems.
